recipes.name: BLT sandwich
steps: Slice the tomato. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the bacon in a pan over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, flipping, until crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Toast the bread.
Spread mayonnaise on each slice.
Layer lettuce, tomato with a pinch of salt and pepper, and 3 slices of bacon on 2 slices of toast.
Top with the other slices and cut in half.

recipes.name: Turkey club sandwich
steps: Cook the bacon in a pan over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, until crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Toast the bread and spread mayonnaise on one side of each slice.
On 2 slices, layer turkey, cheese and a lettuce leaf.
Add a second slice of toast, then bacon, tomato and lettuce.
Top with the last slices, mayo side down.
Push 4 toothpicks into each sandwich and cut into 4 triangles with a sharp knife. Ask an adult to help.

recipes.name: Chicken salad sandwich
ingredients: 3 cups (420 g) cooked chicken, chopped (rotisserie works great)
steps: Chop the chicken and celery and slice the green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, salt and pepper in a bowl.
Fold in the chicken, celery, green onions and grapes.
Taste and add more salt if needed.
Pile onto bread with lettuce.
Keep leftovers in the fridge for up to 3 days.

recipes.name: Egg salad sandwich
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped chives or green onion
steps: Put the eggs in a pot, cover with cold water by 1 inch and bring to a boil.
Turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for 11 minutes.
Cool the eggs in ice water for 5 minutes, then peel. Ask an adult to help with the hot water.
Chop the eggs and put them in a bowl.
Mix in the mayonnaise, mustard, salt, pepper and chives.
Spread on bread with lettuce.

recipes.name: Peanut butter and jelly sandwich
steps: Spread peanut butter on one slice of bread all the way to the edges.
Spread jelly on the other slice.
Add banana slices if you like.
Press the slices together and cut in half.
For a grilled version, butter the outsides and cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side.

recipes.name: Baked ham and cheese sliders
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C). Ask an adult to help.
Without pulling the rolls apart, slice the whole block in half sideways with a bread knife.
Put the bottom half in a 9 by 13 inch baking dish.
Layer the ham and cheese over it and put the top half back on.
Mix the melted butter, mustard, Worcestershire, poppy seeds and onion powder and brush it over the tops.
Cover with foil and bake for 15 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 5 minutes more, until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut along the rolls into 12 sliders.

recipes.name: Reuben sandwich
ingredients: 1/4 cup (60 ml) Russian or Thousand Island dressing
steps: Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Lay 2 slices butter side down and spread the dressing on top.
Layer cheese, corned beef, sauerkraut and more cheese.
Top with the other bread slices, butter side up.
Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 4 to 5 minutes per side, pressing down, until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut in half and serve.

recipes.name: Patty melt
ingredients: 2 tablespoons (30 g) butter, divided, plus more for the bread
steps: Slice the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan over medium-low heat and cook the onion with a pinch of salt for 15 minutes, stirring, until soft and golden.
Shape the beef into 2 thin oval patties the size of the bread and season with the rest of the salt and pepper.
Cook the patties in another pan over medium-high heat for 3 minutes per side, until 160°F (71°C) inside.
Butter the outside of each slice of bread.
Build each sandwich: bread, cheese, patty, onions, cheese, bread.
Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and melty.

recipes.name: Tuna melt
ingredients: 1 tablespoon finely chopped celery or pickle
steps: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, celery, lemon juice and pepper in a bowl.
Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Lay 2 slices butter side down and add a slice of cheese, the tuna, and another slice of cheese.
Top with the other bread, butter side up.
Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Monte Cristo sandwich
ingredients: Powdered sugar and raspberry jam to serve
steps: Build 2 sandwiches with cheese, ham, turkey and more cheese.
Whisk the eggs and milk in a shallow dish.
Melt the butter in a pan over medium-low heat.
Dip each sandwich in the egg mix for a few seconds per side.
Cook for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and the cheese melts.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with jam for dipping.

recipes.name: Cuban sandwich
ingredients: 1 loaf Cuban bread or 2 soft French baguettes
12 oz (340 g) sliced roast pork (leftover or deli)
steps: Cut the bread into 4 pieces about 8 inches long, then split each one. Ask an adult to help.
Spread mustard on both cut sides.
Layer cheese, ham, pork, pickles and more cheese on each.
Butter the outsides of the bread.
Cook in a big pan over medium heat with a heavy pan pressed on top for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until crisp and the cheese melts.
Cut each sandwich in half on an angle.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar wrap
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
steps: Season the chicken with salt, garlic powder and pepper.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 7 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C) inside.
Let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice it. Ask an adult to help.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing, parmesan and croutons.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave for 20 seconds.
Fill each tortilla with salad and chicken, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Cut in half to serve.

recipes.name: Hummus veggie wrap
steps: Slice the cucumber and pepper and grate the carrot. Ask an adult to help.
Spread hummus over each tortilla, leaving a border.
Lay the spinach, vegetables and feta in a line across the middle.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Cut in half on an angle.

recipes.name: Falafel pita
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) dried chickpeas, soaked in water overnight (not canned)
1 cup (30 g) parsley and cilantro leaves
Vegetable oil for frying, or spray for the oven
4 pita breads, tahini sauce, tomato, cucumber and lettuce to serve
steps: Drain the soaked chickpeas well and pat dry. Canned chickpeas are too wet and will fall apart.
Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, spices and salt in a food processor until like coarse sand. Ask an adult to help.
Stir in the baking powder and flour and chill for 30 minutes.
Shape into 16 small patties.
To fry, an adult heats 2 inches of oil to 350°F (175°C) and fries them for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until deep brown.
To bake, heat the oven to 400°F (200°C), spray the patties well with oil, and bake for 25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Stuff into warm pita with tahini sauce, tomato, cucumber and lettuce.

recipes.name: Chicken gyros
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
Sliced tomato, red onion and lettuce
steps: Mix the yogurt, oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, paprika and salt in a bowl.
Add the chicken and coat it. Marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a sheet pan with foil. Ask an adult to help.
Spread the chicken on the pan and roast for 20 to 25 minutes, until 165°F (74°C) inside and browned at the edges.
Rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Warm the pitas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill with chicken, tzatziki, tomato, onion and lettuce and fold up.

recipes.name: Pita pizzas
ingredients: Toppings like pepperoni, peppers, olives or mushrooms
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Lay the pitas on a baking sheet.
Spread 2 tablespoons of sauce on each, leaving a small border.
Add cheese and your toppings and sprinkle with oregano.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese bubbles and the edges are crisp.
Cool for 2 minutes, then cut into wedges.

recipes.name: French bread pizza
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Ask an adult to help.
Cut the bread in half lengthwise, then in half across, to make 4 pieces.
Mix the butter and garlic and brush it over the cut sides.
Bake cut side up for 5 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Spread on the sauce, then the cheese and pepperoni.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the cheese melts and bubbles.

recipes.name: English muffin pizzas
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Ask an adult to help.
Lay the muffin halves on a baking sheet and toast for 5 minutes.
Spread 1 tablespoon of sauce on each half.
Top with cheese and pepperoni.
Bake for 6 to 8 minutes, until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Bean and cheese burritos
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (150 g) shredded cheddar or Monterey Jack
Salsa and sour cream to serve
steps: Warm the beans with the cumin and chili powder in a small pot over medium-low heat for 5 minutes, stirring.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave for 20 seconds so they bend without tearing.
Spread beans down the middle of each tortilla and add rice and cheese.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Toast seam side down in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes per side, until golden.
Serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.name: Air fryer chicken taquitos
ingredients: 1 cup (100 g) shredded Mexican cheese blend
Guacamole and sour cream to serve
steps: Mix the chicken, cream cheese, salsa, cheese and cumin in a bowl.
Wrap the tortillas in a damp paper towel and microwave for 30 seconds so they roll without cracking.
Spread 2 tablespoons of filling along one edge of each tortilla and roll up tightly.
Lay them seam side down in the air fryer basket and spray with oil.
Air fry at 400°F (200°C) for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp and golden.
Serve with guacamole and sour cream.

recipes.name: Bean tostadas
ingredients: 8 tostada shells, or corn tortillas baked until crisp
1 cup (120 g) crumbled queso fresco or shredded cheese
steps: To make your own shells, bake corn tortillas brushed with oil at 400°F (200°C) for 8 to 10 minutes, until crisp. Ask an adult to help.
Warm the beans in a pot or the microwave.
Shred the lettuce and dice the tomato.
Spread a layer of beans on each tostada shell.
Top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, avocado, sour cream and salsa.
Eat right away while crunchy.

recipes.name: Chicken torta
ingredients: 4 slices Oaxaca or Monterey Jack cheese
Shredded lettuce, sliced tomato and pickled jalapenos
steps: Warm the chicken with the salsa in a pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes.
Split the rolls and toast them cut side down in a dry pan for 1 to 2 minutes.
Spread the bottoms with refried beans and the tops with mayonnaise.
Add cheese, chicken, avocado, lettuce, tomato and jalapenos.
Close the rolls and press down a little before eating.

recipes.name: Sopes
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (210 g) shredded cooked chicken or beef
Shredded lettuce, crumbled queso fresco, Mexican crema and salsa
steps: Mix the masa harina, salt and water into a soft dough. Rest for 10 minutes.
Shape into 8 balls and press each into a 3 1/2 inch disk about 1/4 inch thick.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 minutes per side, until spotty.
While still warm, pinch up the edges to make a little rim. Use a towel, they're hot.
Heat the oil in the pan and fry the sopes, flat side down, for 2 minutes, until crisp. Ask an adult to help.
Spread with beans and top with meat, lettuce, cheese, crema and salsa.

recipes.name: Cheese and bean pupusas
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (170 g) shredded mozzarella or quesillo
Curtido (pickled cabbage slaw) and tomato salsa to serve
steps: Mix the masa harina, salt and water into a soft dough. Rest for 10 minutes.
Mix the cheese and beans in a bowl.
Wet your hands, make 8 balls of dough and press a deep well in each.
Put 2 tablespoons of filling in the well and pinch the dough closed around it.
Pat gently between your hands into a 4 inch disk. Patch any cracks.
Cook in an oiled pan over medium heat for 4 minutes per side, until golden spots appear.
Serve hot with curtido and salsa.

recipes.name: Baked beef empanadas
ingredients: 2 boxes (about 20) frozen empanada discs, thawed, or 2 sheets pie crust
steps: Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the beef and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned. Drain the fat.
Stir in the spices, salt and tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes. Let the filling cool for 15 minutes, then mix in the olives and eggs.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Put 2 tablespoons of filling on each disc, fold into a half moon and press the edges with a fork.
Brush with beaten egg and bake on a lined sheet for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Jamaican beef patties
ingredients: 3/4 cup (170 g) cold butter, in cubes
1 teaspoon curry powder, for the filling
1/2 cup (120 ml) water or beef broth
steps: Mix the flour, curry powder, turmeric and salt. Rub in the butter until it looks like peas.
Stir in the ice water to make a dough, press into a disk, wrap and chill for 30 minutes.
Chop the onion and pepper. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the onion in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes, add the beef and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until browned.
Add the thyme, curry powder, scotch bonnet, breadcrumbs and water and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick. Cool.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Roll the dough 1/8 inch thick and cut 8 circles about 6 inches wide.
Put filling on half of each, fold over, and crimp with a fork.
Brush with egg and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until golden.

recipes.name: Bunny chow
ingredients: 2 tablespoons curry powder or Durban masala
1 1/2 lb (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, in bite-size pieces
steps: Chop the onion, garlic, potatoes and chicken. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and stir for 3 minutes.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes, water and salt and bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 30 minutes, until the potatoes are soft and the chicken is 165°F (74°C) inside.
Cut each loaf in half across and hollow out each half, keeping the soft bread you take out.
Spoon the curry into the bread bowls, top with cilantro and use the soft bread for dipping.

recipes.name: Chicken banh mi
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) boneless skinless chicken thighs
1 carrot and 1 small daikon, cut in matchsticks
Mayonnaise, sliced cucumber, sliced jalapeno and cilantro
steps: Mix the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt and soak the carrot and daikon in it for at least 30 minutes. These are quick pickles.
Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar, fish sauce and garlic and coat the chicken in it.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes per side, until 165°F (74°C) inside and sticky.
Rest for 5 minutes and slice thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Split the baguettes and toast them for 2 to 3 minutes.
Spread with mayonnaise and fill with chicken, drained pickles, cucumber, jalapeno and cilantro.

recipes.name: Vietnamese summer rolls
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) thin rice vermicelli noodles
12 cooked shrimp, cut in half lengthwise, or 8 oz (225 g) cooked pork or tofu
Fresh mint, cilantro and Thai basil
steps: Soak the noodles in boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes, until soft. Drain and rinse with cold water. Ask an adult to help.
Cut the cucumber and carrot into thin sticks.
Fill a wide shallow dish with warm water.
Dip one rice paper in the water for 5 seconds and lay it flat on a damp board.
Lay 2 shrimp halves in the middle, then lettuce, a few noodles, vegetables and herbs.
Fold the bottom over, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Whisk the hoisin, peanut butter and warm water to make a dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Bun thit nuong grilled pork noodle bowl
ingredients: 1 lb (450 g) pork shoulder or boneless pork chops, thinly sliced
1 stalk lemongrass, finely chopped, or 1 tablespoon lemongrass paste
Shredded lettuce, cucumber, mint, cilantro and chopped peanuts
Nuoc cham: 3 tablespoons fish sauce, 3 tablespoons sugar, 3 tablespoons lime juice, 1/2 cup (120 ml) warm water, 1 garlic clove grated
steps: Slice the pork thinly. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the fish sauce, brown sugar, lemongrass, garlic and oil and coat the pork. Marinate for 20 minutes.
Stir the nuoc cham ingredients until the sugar dissolves.
Cook the noodles in boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes, then drain and rinse with cold water.
Cook the pork in a hot pan or grill pan over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until browned and cooked through.
Fill bowls with lettuce, cucumber, herbs and noodles, then add the pork and peanuts.
Pour nuoc cham over the top and mix.

recipes.name: Tamago sando Japanese egg sandwich
ingredients: 3 tablespoons Japanese mayonnaise (like Kewpie) or regular mayonnaise
4 slices soft milk bread (shokupan) or soft white bread
steps: Put the eggs in a pot, cover with water and bring to a boil. Turn off the heat, cover, and let sit for 11 minutes.
Cool in ice water and peel. Ask an adult to help with the hot water.
Mash the eggs with a fork, leaving some small pieces of white.
Mix in the mayonnaise, milk, sugar, salt and pepper until creamy.
Spread a thin layer of butter on the bread.
Pile the egg salad thickly onto 2 slices and top with the others.
Cut off the crusts with a sharp knife and cut each sandwich in half.

recipes.name: Chicken katsu sando
ingredients: Vegetable oil for frying, about 1/2 inch
steps: Pound the chicken to an even 1/2 inch thick and season with salt and pepper.
Coat each piece in flour, then egg, then panko. Wash your hands.
Have an adult heat the oil in a pan over medium heat to 350°F (175°C).
Fry the cutlets for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until golden and 165°F (74°C) inside. An adult should do the frying.
Drain on a rack for 2 minutes.
Spread tonkatsu sauce on the bread, add cabbage and the cutlet, and close the sandwich.
Cut off the crusts and slice in half.

recipes.name: Onigiri rice balls
ingredients: 2 cups (400 g) uncooked Japanese short grain rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water is mostly clear, then cook it with the water in a rice cooker or covered pot over low heat for 15 minutes.
Let it steam with the lid on for 10 minutes. Spread it in a bowl to cool until warm, not hot.
Mix the tuna, mayonnaise and soy sauce.
Wet your hands with water and rub a pinch of salt on your palms.
Take 1/2 cup of rice, press a dent in the middle and add 1 teaspoon of tuna filling.
Cover with a little more rice and press firmly into a triangle or ball.
Wrap a strip of nori around the bottom just before eating.

recipes.name: California roll
ingredients: Toasted sesame seeds, soy sauce and pickled ginger
steps: Rinse the rice until the water is mostly clear and cook it with the water in a covered pot over low heat for 15 minutes. Rest for 10 minutes.
Warm the vinegar, sugar and salt until dissolved and fold it into the rice. Cool to room temperature.
Slice the avocado and cucumber. Ask an adult to help.
Lay a nori sheet shiny side down on a bamboo mat covered in plastic wrap.
With wet hands, spread 3/4 cup of rice thinly over the nori, leaving 1 inch bare at the top.
Lay crab, avocado and cucumber in a line across the bottom.
Lift the mat and roll tightly away from you, pressing as you go. Wet the bare edge to seal.
Cut each roll into 8 pieces with a wet sharp knife. Serve with soy sauce and ginger.

recipes.name: Zaru soba cold soba noodles
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) store-bought soba dipping sauce (tsuyu), or the 3 items below
1/2 cup (120 ml) water with 1 teaspoon dashi powder
1 sheet nori, cut in thin strips
steps: If making your own sauce, simmer the soy sauce, mirin and dashi water for 2 minutes, then chill.
Boil the soba in a big pot of water for 4 to 5 minutes, or as the package says.
Drain and rinse under cold running water, rubbing gently to wash off the starch.
Put the noodles in a bowl of ice water for 1 minute, then drain well.
Pile the noodles on plates and top with nori.
Dip each bite into the cold sauce with green onion and a little wasabi.

recipes.name: Yaki udon
ingredients: 2 packs (7 oz / 200 g each) frozen udon noodles
4 oz (115 g) thinly sliced pork, chicken or shrimp
2 green onions, cut in 2 inch pieces
steps: Slice the meat and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Put the frozen udon in boiling water for 1 minute to loosen. Drain.
Mix the soy sauce, oyster sauce, mirin and sugar.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the meat for 2 to 3 minutes, until cooked through.
Add the carrot, cabbage and mushrooms and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the udon, sauce and green onion and toss for 2 minutes, until coated and hot.

recipes.name: Yakisoba
ingredients: 3 packs (5 oz / 150 g each) fresh yakisoba or ramen noodles
8 oz (225 g) thinly sliced pork belly or chicken
Pickled ginger and seaweed flakes (aonori) to serve
steps: Slice the meat and vegetables. Ask an adult to help.
Mix the Worcestershire, ketchup, soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar. This is yakisoba sauce.
Loosen the noodles by rinsing them in hot water.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the meat for 3 to 4 minutes, until cooked through.
Add the onion, carrot and cabbage and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 to 3 minutes, until hot and coated.
Top with pickled ginger and aonori.

recipes.name: Okonomiyaki savory pancakes
ingredients: Okonomiyaki sauce or a mix of ketchup and Worcestershire, Japanese mayo and bonito flakes
steps: Chop the cabbage and green onions. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, dashi powder, water and eggs.
Fold in the cabbage and green onion until coated.
Heat the oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat and spoon in half the batter, shaping a 1 inch thick round.
Lay 4 bacon halves on top.
Cook for 5 minutes, flip carefully with 2 spatulas, and cook for 5 minutes more.
Flip back and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until cooked through. Repeat with the rest.
Top with sauce, mayo and bonito flakes.

recipes.name: Kimbap
ingredients: 3 cups (550 g) cooked short grain rice, warm
1 tablespoon sesame oil, plus more for brushing
steps: Mix the warm rice with the sesame oil and salt.
Cook the eggs as a thin omelette in an oiled pan over medium-low heat for 2 minutes per side, then cut into strips. Ask an adult to help.
Cook the carrot in a little oil for 2 minutes. Blanch the spinach in boiling water for 30 seconds, squeeze dry and season with a pinch of salt.
Lay a nori sheet shiny side down on a bamboo mat and spread 3/4 cup of rice thinly over it, leaving 1 inch bare at the top.
Lay a strip of each filling across the bottom third.
Roll up tightly with the mat and press to seal.
Brush the roll with sesame oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Slice into 1/2 inch pieces with a wet sharp knife.

recipes.name: Tteokbokki spicy rice cakes
ingredients: 3 cups (720 ml) water or anchovy broth
1 tablespoon gochugaru (Korean chili flakes), or less for mild
2 sheets fish cake, cut in triangles (optional)
2 green onions, cut in 2 inch pieces
steps: If the rice cakes are hard, soak them in warm water for 10 minutes.
Bring the water to a boil in a wide pan and stir in the gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce and sugar.
Add the rice cakes and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often so they don't stick.
Add the fish cake, green onion and eggs and cook for 3 to 5 minutes more, until the sauce is thick and glossy.
Serve hot. Careful, rice cakes hold heat for a long time.

recipes.name: Kimchi fried rice
ingredients: 1 cup (150 g) chopped kimchi, plus 2 tablespoons kimchi juice
4 oz (115 g) diced ham, Spam or bacon (optional)
steps: Chop the kimchi and ham. Ask an adult to help.
Heat the oil in a big pan over medium-high heat and cook the ham for 2 minutes.
Add the kimchi and cook for 3 minutes.
Add the rice, kimchi juice, gochujang, soy sauce and sugar and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes, until hot.
Stir in the sesame oil and divide between 2 bowls.
Fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set, and put one on each bowl.
Top with green onion.

recipes.name: Spam musubi
ingredients: 3 cups (550 g) cooked short grain rice, warm
steps: Slice the Spam into 8 slices. Ask an adult to help.
Fry the slices in the oil over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until browned.
Mix the soy sauce, sugar and mirin and pour it into the pan. Simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, turning the Spam, until glazed.
Lay a half sheet of nori shiny side down. Use the empty Spam can (both ends cut off, edges checked by an adult) or a musubi mold as a press.
Press 1/3 cup of rice into the mold on the nori, add a slice of Spam, and press again.
Lift off the mold and wrap the nori around, wetting the end to seal.

recipes.name: Loco moco
steps: Shape the beef into 4 patties and season with salt and pepper. Wash your hands.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the patties for 4 minutes per side, until 160°F (71°C) inside. Keep them warm.
Chop the onion. Ask an adult to help.
Melt the butter in the same pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 3 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the broth, soy sauce and Worcestershire.
Simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, until thick.
Fry the eggs for 2 to 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Put rice in each bowl, then a patty, gravy and a fried egg.
